messages.subject: monthplot using ggplot2
parts:
Hi dear list,
I would like to know if there's a way to make a monthplot (or cycle plot) using ggplot ?
Like this one for example :

data(co2)
fit <- stl(log(co2), s.window = 20, t.window = 20)
monthplot(fit, choice = "seasonal", cex.axis = 0.8)
 
thanks

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: monthplot using ggplot2
parts:
Hi,

this is probably near from what you want:

d <- data.frame(m=factor(1:12, labels=month.abb),
x=time(fit$time.series), fit$time.series)

ggplot(d, aes(x, seasonal)) +
geom_line() +
stat_smooth(method="lm", formula=y~1, se=F) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks=NA) +
facet_wrap(~m, nrow=1)

--
